title: Marketing & Sales Executive
short_description: Nexus Nutraceuticals is looking for an energetic, confident, and result-oriented Marketing & Sales Executive to help promote and grow our health and wellness products.
full_description:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic person who can help us grow the Nexus Nutraceuticals brand and promote our products in the market.

Our current product is:
**NEXUS Vitamin B12 + D3 Water-Soluble Powder**

The candidate will play an important role in increasing product awareness, finding new customers, building business relationships, and generating sales opportunities.
education_required: Any Graduate, Diploma or equivalent qualification. Relevant sales or marketing experience may also be considered.
salary_display: As per Experience + Attractive Performance-Based Incentives
responsibilities: Promoting Nexus Nutraceuticals products in the local market.
Finding new customers and business opportunities.
Visiting medical stores, pharmacies, wellness centres, clinics, and other relevant businesses.
Building relationships with potential retailers, distributors, dealers, and business partners.
Explaining product features and benefits professionally and accurately.
Supporting product promotions and marketing campaigns.
Generating leads and converting potential customers into sales opportunities.
Following up with interested customers and business partners.
Supporting promotional activities, exhibitions, health camps, and local events when required.
Helping grow product awareness in Ahmedabad and other target markets.
Collecting market feedback and competitor information.
Suggesting new marketing and sales ideas.
Maintaining records of leads, visits, follow-ups, and sales activities.
Submitting daily or weekly activity reports.
Working towards assigned sales and marketing targets.
required_skills: Willingness to travel locally for field work
preferred_skills: Experience with medical stores or pharmacies
Experience in FMCG, healthcare, wellness, supplements, or nutraceutical products

benefits.title: Growing Brand
benefits.description: Be part of a growing health and wellness company.

benefits.title: Career Growth
benefits.description: Get opportunities to learn, develop, and grow with the business. As Nexus Nutraceuticals grows, committed and high-performing team members will have opportunities for increased responsibilities and career growth.

benefits.title: Performance Rewards
benefits.description: Your hard work and results can be rewarded through attractive performance-based incentives.

benefits.title: Dynamic Work Environment
benefits.description: Work in a fast-moving environment where your ideas and efforts can make a real difference.

benefits.title: Meaningful Products
benefits.description: Help promote products focused on health and wellness.
